title: Don’t waste your money. This is only gift table if you hate the person you’re sending it to.
text: Don’t waste your money. This is only gift table if you hate the person you’re sending it to.. From the moment I unwrapped the blanket until I sent it back that thing left lint balls all over my house and bed. I thought maybe washing it would help control some of the piling and lint but it only increased it. So unless you want to let roll or vacuum all the time just for the sake of a blanket that will irritate your eyes and nose I wouldn’t recommend this. I was more than happy to return the blanket because I didn’t want it even in my house. Amazon refunded my money.
